hero.subheadline: Our founders and lead advisors have built billion-dollar infrastructure and managed global tech portfolios. Meet the team.

sections.title: Built on Experience, Driven by Mission
sections.body: The leadership of Kenya AI Compute is a diverse group of professionals united by the conviction that the next phase of the digital economy will be built in Africa. Our CEO brings over 15 years of experience in international business consulting across 50 countries, specializing in complex infrastructure modeling. Our technical leads come from the front lines of European data center design and high-density power engineering. Rounding out the team are experts in African GR (Government Relations) who have successfully navigated the regulatory landscape of Kenya's burgeoning tech sector. This combination of global strategy and local operational grit is what allows us to execute with a speed and precision that traditional firms cannot match. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
